plan: Given my private value of $30, I should aim to bid slightly above the average expected value of my competitors to maximize profit. Since values range from $0 to $20, a rational bid would be slightly above $20. I will bid $20.1 to potentially win the auction while minimizing costs, as this is the maximum likely value of other bidders.

Given my private value of $25, which is above the maximum possible value of $20, I should aim to bid slightly above the average expected bid of the other bidders. Assuming rational behavior, they might bid around their value. To maximize profit, I can bid slightly above $20, ensuring I win while paying as little as possible. I will bid $20.5 to outbid any rational competitor bidding up to their maximum value.

Given my private value of $22, I should aim to bid slightly above the expected average bid of my competitors to maximize profit. Assuming rational behavior, they might bid near their value, which averages to $10. Bidding $15.1 balances winning likelihood and profit margin, as it exceeds the average expectation while staying below my value, ensuring a positive profit if I win.
